name: B1 interpretable train-only confidence
population: Exactly all 150 measured_only runs in baselines/final-1.json, as partitioned by round2-evaluation.json. No rendering or detection/position changes.
training: 68 train runs, 17 scene IDs with seed 1 or 2 and both realism profiles. Every matched fix episode and unmatched emitted fix is a binary training label; misses are not fabricated labels.
validation: 82 remaining runs, seen round-one held-out data; accept/reject only.
unavailable_features: window SNR in dB (not stored in round-one inference)
cross_fitting: Five folds by lexically sorted training scene ID index modulo five; all seeds and realism variants of a scene stay together.

probability_calibration.method: Platt intercept and slope fit only on train-site out-of-fold logits

flag_threshold: Half the minimum predicted probability among wrong train fixes across full-fit and out-of-fold predictions. If no wrong train fixes, threshold 0 (flag all; insufficient labels). No validation threshold search.
radius: Per realism profile, finite-sample corrected empirical 90th percentile of training horizontal error divided by geometric scale = max_range * radians(hypot(declared_heading_sigma, bearing_sigma)) / max(0.05, crossing_sine), floored at 0.1 m. Unmatched fixes have unknown error and do not enter radius fitting. Quantile unavailable if ceil(0.9*(n+1)) exceeds n.
acceptance: Mission rule 4 on all four train/validation by realism partitions. Exact paired bootstrap aggregate deltas, 1000 draws, 95% CI. No promotion if any partition fails.
limitations: Cross-conformal-style empirical radius only; correlated episodes/sites and synthetic propagation invalidate a guaranteed real-world coverage claim. Report reliability bins, Brier score, flags and radius coverage per partition.
